requires: PG runtime libraries via LD_LIBRARY_PATH, same defaults as tests/e2e/run_data_plane.py

isolation.lock: /home/compile/Work/.locks/proxypanel-webdemo-local-runtime.lock via flock -w600, taken before the before-snapshot and released after cleanup
isolation.clusters: two brand-new initdb clusters, private unix socket directories, random 127.0.0.1 ports, random owned databases
isolation.agent: new owned state directory plus a stopped-state copy; real cmd/agent process; explicit -accept-generation on the shipped binary

evidence.runner_receipt: runner-receipt.json (status, tools, assets, source/target ports, existing-object before/after identity)
evidence.test_receipt: receipt.json (assertions, backup digest, generations, ledger totals, equivalence table, not_run)

assertions: real pg_dump --format=custom (PGDMP header, digest recorded) of the source cluster
real pg_restore --exit-on-error into a second, distinct owned cluster
restored panel enters a fresh exact-integer control generation different from backup, surviving source and Agent copy
ordinary admin and member authorization writes are blocked with 409 RECOVERY_MODE; identity rescue (own password) and Agent telemetry stay usable
an exit without explicit agent_revisions_checked/ledger_checked is refused
a verified exit rotates the generation again; every Agent must explicitly accept the new one
ledger equals backup ledger plus the externally queued Agent batches, byte/payload identical, replay idempotent
post-backup ACK-deleted batches are never fabricated after restore
recorded cycle intervals are conserved and replayed usage lands inside exactly one recorded interval
an interval with no recorded cycle is refused with LEDGER_UNATTRIBUTABLE, nothing ACKed, nothing moved into the current cycle
same batch id with a different payload is stopped with BATCH_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH
the permanently revoked old credential and its export stay denied before replay, after acceptance and after restart
the restored Agent refuses the new generation (coordination_required, pending set, zero queue) until -accept-generation
after verification the restored panel's new export tunnels real traffic
surviving source control state, revocation, ledger and the backup file are unchanged
exclusions: WAL archiving / PITR / production RPO or RTO
technical old-release binary stop-write rollback (separate maintenance path, reported as not_run)
multi-node coordination beyond the single owned Agent
